offer.text: Archers of bone are picking at our patrols from the ruins. Put down 5 and the roads grow safer.

accept.text: Close the distance fast — they're deadly at range. Go.

decline.text: Then keep to cover when you travel.

in_progress.text: How many skeletons still rattle out there?

ready.text: Five clattering heaps. The patrols can breathe easier.

complete.text: Steady aim and a steadier nerve. The watch salutes you.
